after_failure: Retain valid failure; do not extend this envelope again to obtain success.

aggregate_time_only_limits_s.derivation: One-encounter totals add 300 seconds; three-encounter totals add 600 seconds to the sums of encounter limits for initialization and intervening A/B work. Existing per-job waits stay unchanged.

clock_semantics.encounter_sim_s: Elapsed continuously running simulation time from accepted start-invocation.
clock_semantics.encounter_wall_s: Elapsed monotonic host wall time from accepted start-invocation; never reset by commands.
clock_semantics.model_invocation_s: Existing app-server invocation deadline, starting at its current invocation boundary.
